purpose: Test the exact locked P0685 zero-slip field against spent RX J2129 image positions, global roots, multiplicity, parity, and critical curves with no fitted gravity or photon amplitude.

nuisance_fit.source_positions: two coordinates profiled independently for each of seven spectroscopic families on training images
nuisance_fit.map_interpolation: bicubic spline inside the fixed P0685 field; no ellipticity, rotation, radial amplitude, mass sheet, or slip is fitted

global_topology.critical_curve_present: at least one horizontal or vertical sign-changing cell in det(d beta/d theta)
global_topology.parity_diverse: the globally recovered roots for a family contain at least one positive and one negative determinant

selection_rule: Advance to frozen resolution and baryonic-map robustness only if the unretuned P0685 field passes every exact-root, absolute residual, compact-halo comparison, global multiplicity, parity, critical-curve, nuisance-bound, and parameter-accounting gate. Heldout images select nothing.
claim_boundary: Every RX J2129 image is spent; P0686 can reject or diagnose this generator but cannot validate it.
The finite global seed search can miss roots with very small basins or beyond 48 arcseconds.
Catalog incompleteness makes demagnified surplus roots less decisive than observable surplus roots.
The 33-cell field is coarse for critical curves; a pass must be followed by frozen resolution convergence.
P0633 galaxy kinematics and P0640 cluster lens constraints remain sealed.
